summary: Full-stack testing of LLHS MVP passed. 19/19 backend pytest cases green including auth (register/login/me/dup/unauth), Mini-EAT onboarding (diet_quality computation + eligible flag), meals+twin persistence, activity/sleep, safety layer (3 skipped meals -> supportive check-in -> ack), curriculum idempotent completion, games completion with markers, gamification (points/badges/streak), cooperative cohort, Claude Sonnet 5 chat with citations+disclaimer, and Gemini 3 Flash photo analysis on a real generated food JPEG (returns items, has_vegetables, confidence, needs_confirmation). Frontend flows verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): welcome -> login (demo@llhs.app) -> Health HQ (twin arc 60/100 vs peer 58, Food/Move/Rest bars with Rest 'low confidence' badge visible, cohort card, streak/badges, points chip) -> log-meal modal (Food/Move/Rest tabs, meal-name, portion pills, whole/veg/protein/sodium toggles, save-meal). After saving a meal, Food bar updated (100->75 due to unbalanced test meal), overall score recomputed (60->54), and points incremented (+10). Coach tab returned a grounded 150-min/week reply with illustrative disclaimer footer. Twin detail modal correctly shows SUPPRESSED trajectory with 'Log a few more balanced meals to unlock your trajectory' (matches ENGINE-05 rule) + NHANES peer-comparison table. Learn tab renders 3-part video series and 3 mini-game cards; game g1 'Plan Your Week' opens scenario with 3 choices. No React Native red screens. Deprecated packages detected: none. React-native-web console warnings observed (non-blocking): transform-origin DOM prop, shadow* style deprecated, pointerEvents prop deprecated.

issues: Console warning: Invalid DOM property `transform-origin` - should use `transformOrigin` camelCase in inline styles (likely from an SVG/animation lib).
Console warning: `shadow*` style props are deprecated in RN Web - migrate to `boxShadow`.

action_items: Optional polish: silence RN-web deprecation warnings (transform-origin -> transformOrigin; shadow* -> boxShadow; pointerEvents to style). Non-blocking, cosmetic only.
Optional: add testIDs for chat-input and chat-send to make future chat testing more robust (currently discoverable via input tag only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~870 lines and mixes engine, safety, KB, and routes. Consider splitting into modules (auth, engine, safety, chat, photo) once feature-complete.
chat retrieval scoring double-counts (tags + word-in-tag substring) - works for MVP but may over-match for short queries; consider IDF-like weighting.
compute_twin is invoked twice on meal create (once in run_safety_check indirectly? No - only once). Fine.
MongoDB _id is correctly stripped in list_meals / get_checkin / etc.
All endpoints properly require Bearer auth via current_user.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (welcome, login, HQ, twin detail suppressed, log-meal save, coach chat, learn, games)

seed_data_creation: Registered ~5 ephemeral test users via /api/auth/register with @example.com emails during pytest run. Demo account demo@llhs.app used for frontend flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Pytest uses example.com emails because pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD as reserved. Frontend requires clicking 'I already have an account' text (no testID exposed for that link). Photo test synthesizes a real JPEG with PIL depicting plate + broccoli + rice + chicken, then base64-encodes it. Gemini call took ~7s in test env. Safety check-in dedupes within 24h - use fresh users for that path.
